<|python_tag|>from collections import defaultdict

# Create a dictionary to store the count of messages for each user
user_message_count = defaultdict(int)

# Count the messages for each user in each channel
channels = ["general", "random", "private"]
for channel in channels:
    if channel == "general":
        messages = [
            {"body": "Secret key is 1a7b3d.", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Charlie"},
            {"body": "I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Bob"},
            {"body": "Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Eve"}
        ]
    elif channel == "random":
        messages = [
            {"body": "Has anyone seen my coffee mug?", "recipient": "random", "sender": "Alice"}
        ]
    elif channel == "private":
        messages = [
            {"body": "just testing", "recipient": "private", "sender": "Charlie"}
        ]
    
    for message in messages:
        user_message_count[message["sender"]] += 1

# Sort the users by the count of messages and then by their names
sorted_users = sorted(user_message_count.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))

# Send a direct message to each user with their rank
for i, (user, count) in enumerate(sorted_users):
    print(f"Congrats on being the {i+1}-th most active user!")
    #
